name: Minimal Helper
description: Companion for the Minimal texture pack: one continuous background animation across every menu, play button opens your favorite levels, and a few layout fixes.

continuous-background.name: Continuous background
continuous-background.description: The nebula drift and star twinkle keep going smoothly when you switch screens instead of restarting.

flowing-background.name: Flowing clouds background
flowing-background.description: Menu backgrounds become slowly flowing clouds drawn live (no stars). Off = the texture pack's own nebula and stars.

background-speed.name: Cloud speed
background-speed.description: How fast the clouds flow. 1 = default.

clean-loading-screen.name: Nebula loading screen
clean-loading-screen.description: The game's loading screen uses the menu nebula instead of the blue squares. Takes effect next time the game starts.

play-opens-favorites.name: Play opens favorite levels
play-opens-favorites.description: The big play button on the main menu opens your favorite levels. The main levels are in Settings.

levels-in-settings.name: Main levels button in Settings
levels-in-settings.description: Turns the Rate button in Settings into a Levels button that opens the main levels.

clean-level-lists.name: Clean saved/favorite lists
clean-level-lists.description: Hides the info button in the bottom left of saved and favorite levels and puts the heart there instead.

equal-pause-buttons.name: Same size side buttons
equal-pause-buttons.description: Every button on the left and right of the pause menu, and on the left of the icon kit, gets the same size.

square-play-loading.name: Square level loading
square-play-loading.description: When you press play on a level, the loading progress is a thin square around the play box instead of a ring on top of it.

round-fill.name: Rounded slider fill
round-fill.description: Volume sliders and the loading bar get a fill with rounded ends that matches the groove.
